title: Ascent alignment: 1:1 briefing and follow-ups (manager↔report)
content:
Purpose: quick alignment before our weekly 1:1. This is a scratchpad — keep short, pull the highlights into the meeting, and convert the bullets below into 3 concrete commits by EOD.

Topline context
- Micah (report): finishing rollout integration for dynamic batching; still measuring tail-latency outliers.
- Manager asks: unblock perf experiments, career conversation (IC->tech lead path), and sync on staffing requests.

Agenda (30m)
1) 5m — Quick wins & mood check
   - Rapid pulse: how's energy? Any immediate friction? One-word status.
2) 10m — Technical checkpoint: dynamic batching rollout
   - Current metric: p95 latency at 420ms, target 300ms for RL workload.
   - Hypothesis: outliers due to sparse KV cache miss pattern + CPU context-switch around batching flush.
   - Experiment status: A/B running on 2 replicas (canary), sample size n~12k tokens/day.
   - Ask: approval to expand canary to 6 replicas for weekend smoke test.
3) 8m — Career + scope conversation
   - Micah wants clearer path to tech lead: ownership examples, leadership exposure.
   - Manager to propose a 90-day ownership plan (own one perf initiative end-to-end).
4) 5m — Admin & follow-ups
   - Staffing request recap: 0.25 FTE for infra test automation (Q2).
   - Blockers: access to GPU quota in staging (ticket ENG-512 blocked).

Pre-meeting prep (micah)
- Bring: short log extract showing KV cache hit skew (attach top 3 sessions).
- Prep a 2-slide, 3-bullet summary of the canary results (latency percentiles, failure modes, cost delta).
- List 2 concrete asks for manager: (1) canary scale approval; (2) sponsor intro to product for prioritization.

Questions I want to surface (manager prompts)
- "What's the one bottleneck that, if removed, gets p95 under 300ms?"
- "Which part of the rollout is highest risk for production users?"
- "If you had an extra 0.25 FTE for a quarter, how would you allocate it?"

Signals to watch (post-meeting quick checks)
- Canary error rate diverges by >0.5% relative to baseline over 12h.
- KV cache hit ratio drops below 78% on sequences >1024 tokens.
- CI nightly integration sees >3 flaky failures (new pattern).

Action items (convert into tasks during/after meeting)
- Micah: upload 2-slide summary to GitHub PR and tag manager (due: 2026-02-11).
- Manager: approve canary scale to 6 replicas for weekend test (decide before EOD).
- Micah + DevOps: unblock ENG-512 (request temporary staging GPU quota; owner: Priya) (due: 2026-02-12).
- Manager: draft a 90-day ownership plan template and share a sample from a previous tech lead (due: 2026-02-16).

Micro commitments (what success looks like in next check-in)
- Canary expanded, 48h smoke run, p95 < 350ms and no >1% increase in failures.
- Ownership plan agreed and one cross-team meeting scheduled with product.

Open unknowns / notes to self
- Might need to cut back on aggressive batching for the RL workload; trade-off doc required.
- Check with SRE on whether autoscaler logs show `scale_down` chatter at boundary conditions.
- Pull upstream PRs that touch batching-flush behavior; flag any API contract changes.

Risk log (one-liners)
- User-facing regressions if canary expands without proper rate-limiting.
- Career: Micah needs a visible cross-team deliverable to be considered for tech lead by Q3.

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack/Asana)
- Short headline (1 sentence).
- Decisions made (list).
- Next steps (3 items with owners and due dates).
- Quick vibes summary (one sentence).

Misc references / links to pull in
- Confluence: Perf Runbook (link to confluence page)
- GitHub PR: serving-runtime#514 (see test plan section)
- Jira: ENG-482 (dynamic-batching), ENG-512 (staging quota)

Notes-to-self: keep this doc ephemeral. After the meeting, move the final action list into Asana and paste the 1-sentence headline in #eng-micah-thread.

End of scratchpad.
